journey: Prove that the frozen publication scope is complete, coherent, closed or contractually open, replayably audited, stale-safe, terminated with no active writer or transaction, and delivered as an immutable reader-safe edition with verifiable artifacts.

protocol.blueQuestion: Does this requirement consume a frozen full-book publication scope to prove completion, cross-domain closure, audit replay, staleness, source coverage, or safe terminal quiescence?
protocol.redQuestion: Is it actually a control needed from the first continuous drafting chapter, or does it infer book completion from file counts, one completed runtime, an empty queue, a model score, or a mutable status?
protocol.rule: RP5 owns continuous-run safety from the first drafting action; RP8 owns only terminal evidence that cannot exist until the book, obligations, revision, and active writers have converged.

present: A single-chapter runtime pipeline supports queued, running, paused, review_required, completed, failed, and cancelled statuses
The runtime UI projects a completed run as 100 percent and labels it as autopilot completed
A real imported project contains 198 planned chapters and substantial drafted content
The browser can download a mutable project audit report as JSON
contradictoryOrInsufficient: The runtime start path calls runSingleChapterPipeline rather than a first-class BookRun work graph
The UI completion label has no draft/review/closure/audited completion denominator
The sampled 198-chapter project has 70 drafted and 128 planned chapters, contradicting full-book completion
No full-book CompletionReport, replayable CompletionAudit, ObligationCoverageCertificate, quiescence proof, or stale audited_complete authority was found
No ManuscriptRelease, EditionManifest, publication tree, reader-safe manuscript artifact, deterministic renderer, artifact hash set, or DeliveryProof was found

moved.title: 一等整书运行
moved.reason: BookRun becomes the governing continuous-drafting aggregate before the first autonomous chapter, not after the manuscript is finished.

moved.title: 显式依赖任务图
moved.reason: The dependency work graph must order planning, drafting, review, and settlement from the first chapter.

moved.title: 多时间尺度滚动规划
moved.reason: Rolling book, volume, near-chapter, and scene horizons govern continuous drafting decisions.

moved.title: 有范围的自治授权
moved.reason: Autonomy scope must constrain the first unattended drafting action.

moved.title: 多重执行上限
moved.reason: Call, cost, time, chapter, and failure ceilings are pre-execution safety controls.

moved.title: 启动前预测与预检
moved.reason: Readiness and cost prediction are required before starting a continuous drafting run.

moved.title: 状态语义分层
moved.reason: Run state semantics must distinguish pause, gate, scope completion, and audited completion throughout execution.

moved.title: 工作项幂等与产物契约
moved.reason: Idempotency and artifact contracts protect every drafting work item from duplicate writes and charges.

moved.title: 章节结算事务
moved.reason: Chapter settlement is the dependency boundary that unlocks the next chapter.

moved.title: 风险门禁与批量审阅
moved.reason: Risk gates and review bundling govern decisions during drafting, not only at completion.

moved.title: `autoContinue` 可验证语义
moved.reason: autoContinue semantics are first exercised when one settled chapter schedules the next.

moved.title: 作者方向的因果生效
moved.reason: Author direction must causally affect in-flight and future drafting work.

moved.title: 分级暂停与恢复
moved.reason: Pause and resumable checkpoints are runtime safety controls for continuous drafting.

moved.title: 停止与紧急制动
moved.reason: Stop and emergency fencing must exist before any unattended canon write.

moved.title: 租约、心跳与单写者
moved.reason: Leases, heartbeats, and fencing prevent concurrent chapter or canon writes.

moved.title: 阶段感知恢复
moved.reason: Stage-aware recovery is needed after planning, model, candidate, or commit interruption.

moved.title: 公平调度与资源互斥
moved.reason: Fair scheduling and write-set exclusion govern long runs while other projects remain usable.

moved.title: 停滞与循环检测
moved.reason: Loop and stagnation detection must stop waste during repeated drafting or repair.

moved.title: 证据化重规划
moved.reason: Evidence-driven replanning reacts to settled chapters and author direction during the run.

moved.title: 版本与新鲜度传播
moved.reason: Freshness propagation prevents old contract and outline inputs from being settled during drafting.

moved.title: 失败隔离与降级
moved.reason: Failure classification and isolation determine whether drafting pauses, degrades, or safely continues.

moved.title: 真实进度与预测
moved.reason: Real chapter, work-item, coverage, and obligation progress must be visible throughout the run.

moved.title: 安静时段与通知摘要
moved.reason: Quiet-hour policy and notification summaries govern unattended drafting communication.

conclusion: RP8 retains 16 terminal completion and manuscript-delivery requirements and moves 23 continuous-run controls to RP5; Q-003 is closed at specification level, while RP5 remains unimplemented and no evidence proves full-book completion or artifact delivery.
